notes.title: Foosball VR 0.6 has been released!
notes.content:
We are proud to release [b]Foosball VR[/b] version 0.6

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/yPliW3Qu/1-11-players-table]11-Players Table[/url]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/wLoW2YqZ/4-controller-buttons-settings]Controller Buttons Settings[/url]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/6gAfO5VJ/12-rise-lower-axis-helper]Rise/Lower Axis Helper[/url]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/LT0WyZNT/13-recenter-axis-helper]Recenter Axis Helper[/url]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/SgkiWoPb/14-enhanced-on-bording-tutorial]Enhanced On-bording Tutorial[/url]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/UBNqm2d7/15-axis-snap-helper]Axis Snap Helper[/url]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/m3CPn4gB/18-more-sfx]More SFX[/url]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/as3iwC3t/19-optimisation-pass]Optimisation Pass[/url]
    [*][url=https://trello.com/c/kMwxmcJF/22-ui-visual-improvements]UI Visual Improvements[/url]
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
    [*][url=https://bitbucket.org/coduar/foosballvr/issues/1/onboarding-tutorial-is-broken-after]OnBoarding - tutorial is broken after watching it more than once[/url]
    [*][url=https://bitbucket.org/coduar/foosballvr/issues/2/ui-control-visual-state-retention-when]UI control visual state retention when dismissing the UI entirely[/url]
[/list]

[b]Known bugs:[/b]
Please refer to our [url=https://bitbucket.org/coduar/foosballvr/issues?status=new&status=open]public issue tracker[/url][bitbucket.org]

notes.title: Foosball VR 0.5.1 has been released!
notes.content:
We are proud to release [b]Foosball VR[/b] version 0.5.1

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Settings are now persisted between game launches,
[*] The current tutorial state is properly displayed in the UI,
[*] Change in AI difficulty resets the game if one is in progress,
[*] The tutorial voice level has been increased,
[*] Some added visual enhancements regarding hands interactions with the environment.
[/list]

[b]Known bugs:[/b]
Please refer to our [url=https://bitbucket.org/coduar/foosballvr/issues?status=new&status=open] public issue tracker[/url]
